svg.title: How Pukaar fits together
svg.desc: Logos Basecamp 0.3.1 hosts two modules on one deck. pukaar_ui is a QML panel that polls every 2 seconds and sends JSON to pukaar_core through callModuleAsync, falling back to callModule. pukaar_core is a Rust cdylib carrying the pukaar_logic stack: event, store, sync, reducer, node, identity, checkpoint, persist. It talks to delivery_module, whose Reliable Channels on the content topic /pukaar/1/site-<site_hex>/proto link peer devices peer to peer; each peer carries the same stack. A checkpoint, the Merkle root of every author's chain head, leaves as a printed spel anchor command and lands on LEZ in pukaar_registry as CheckpointRecord PDAs.
svg.text: Rules run on every device. Only a checkpoint root goes on chain.

g.text: anchor path: checkpoint → spel anchor → CheckpointRecord
